author: Praxis VI
title: Diagnostics (test): Graph-space uniformity — raw PCs vs residualized PCs (Praxis path)
abstract: Reconstructs Praxis graph PCs (FWPCA-weighted PCA50) directly from normalized counts, computes per‑PC variance uniformity before and after batch residualization (λ=0.605, γ_max=0.70), and prints JSON. Probes whether residualization flattens PC variance or concentrates covariance.
